description:
Overview 

 Are you excited by the challenge of developing tools and technology to uncover patterns, relationships, and trends in spatial and spatiotemporal data? Do you love turning messy, real-world questions into clear, trustworthy analysis? Join the Spatial Statistics team and help build the next generation of analytical tools and capabilities in ArcGIS.

 As a Product Engineer on the Spatial Statistics team, you'll work closely with software developers, researchers, product managers, and users to design, test, and deliver analytical tools that help people understand where things happen, why they happen, and what may happen next. You'll translate user needs into powerful analytical workflows, define product requirements, and help deliver production-ready software that is thoroughly tested and documented. If you're curious, collaborative, and passionate about solving real-world problems with spatial analysis, we'd love to hear from you.

 Responsibilities 

 
 Research, design, test, and document new spatial statistics and spatial data science tools in ArcGIS

 Collaborate with users to understand analytical challenges and translate them into product requirements and software capabilities

 Validate analytical methods and ensure tools produce reliable, interpretable, and trustworthy results

 Develop sample datasets, documentation, tutorials, and educational material to support user success

 Research emerging approaches in spatial analysis, statistics, machine learning, and GeoAI and evaluate their application within ArcGIS

 Work closely with developers, designers, and product teams to create and ship high quality software in an agile environment

 Support user adoption through documentation, presentations, demonstrations, conferences, and engagement with the GIS community

 
 Requirements 

 
 1 year of experience with ArcGIS Pro, including spatial analysis, geoprocessing, and data management

 Strong understanding of GIS concepts and spatial analytical methods

 Demonstrated experience with at least one programming language such as Python, R, C#, or JavaScript

 Strong problem solving skills with the ability to evaluate analytical workflows and interpret results

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 Ability to work collaboratively in a highly interactive and cross-functional team environment

 Bachelor's degree in GIS, geography, spatial data science, statistics, computer science, engineering, environmental sciences, urban planning or a related field

 
 Recommended Qualifications 

 
 Experience with spatial statistics, predictive modeling, machine learning, or GeoAI

 Experience translating user needs into product requirements, software designs, or analytical workflows

 Experience creating technical documentation, tutorials, training materials, or conference presentations

 Familiarity with scientific methods, quantitative analysis, and reproducible research practices

 Master's or PhD in GIS, geography, spatial data science, statistics, computer science, engineering, environmental sciences, urban planning, or a related field

 Total Rewards 

 Esri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

 A reasonable estimate of the base salary range is
 $70,304 — $109,200 USD 


 The Company 

 At Esri, diversity is more than just a word on a map. When employees of different experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and cultures come together, we are more innovative and ultimately a better place to work. We believe in having a diverse workforce that is unified under our mission of creating positive global change. We understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion is not a destination but an ongoing process. We are committed to the continuation of learning, growing, and changing our workplace so every employee can contribute to their life’s best work. Our commitment to these principles extends to the global communities we serve by creating positive change with GIS technology. For more information on Esri’s Racial Equity and Social Justice initiatives, please visit our website here .

 If you don’t meet all of the preferred qualifications for this position, we encourage you to still apply!

Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this e-mail address.

 Esri Privacy Esri takes our responsibility to protect your privacy seriously.
